working_set_scope: Maximum sampled Windows PeakWorkingSet64 of each test process, sampled about every 20 ms. Includes App, HTTP fixtures, client, Go runtime and tests. Excludes PostgreSQL and the sampler.

workload.resource_sample_scope: six phase snapshots; GC deltas from first runtime sample, nanoseconds; managed PG snapshots cover only this App writer and its media lane connections, state and wait types are counts not wait durations; slow counters are per App incarnation
workload.scope: single local writer, two workspaces, six chat executions and six native asynchronous media tasks; samples include test HTTP servers; Go Sys excludes other processes and is not RSS
workload.wait_definition: wall time from before submission via authenticated HTTP to provider adapter entry, includes admission and queue; fixed fixture barriers hold selected calls
